name: AssetNotify
description:
- Ships a completed design artifact (logo, mockup, or spec file) from the Otherside Design canvas surface back into the main otherside conversation
- Use this when the design surface has produced a file the user should see, edit, or commit
- Path must be absolute or resolvable from the current working directory; Otherside Design will canonicalize it
- A short `note` (one sentence) helps the main agent understand what was produced and why

Usage:
- `kind`: one of `logo`, `mockup`, or `spec`
- `path`: filesystem path to the produced artifact
- `note`: optional one-line description of what was produced

Behavior:
- Emits a transcript hint to the main otherside agent via the notification pipeline
- Does NOT modify the file in any way — it only notifies
- Never echoes raw user input; only the canonical path and your `kind`/`note` flow through

After calling, the main agent will see the artifact path and can decide whether to Read it, Edit it, or take other action.

kind.description: Artifact category produced by the design surface.

path.description: Filesystem path to the produced artifact. Absolute or resolvable from cwd.

note.description: Optional one-line description of what was produced.
